notes.title: Update 1.1 comes a bit late... ^^U
notes.notes:
I made a few changes that i think make it better.

Survival mode has been removed. It made no sense in the game.
I added infinite levels as the game is procedurally generated.
There is now a leaderboard with your best scores of highest level achieved and playing time.
I removed the bomb. It was unbalanced and made everything much harder to read.
Fix some bug at the beginning blocking the exit door of the tutorial.
Fixes some wierd issues that blocked character movement right after starting a level.
The whole game was balanced.
Minor changes and bug fixes

notes.title: Caterva release!
notes.notes:
Caterva has just come out!
It’s a big step for me, even if it doesn’t get too much attention.
I am very proud to have reached this point.
For now, I just hope you to enjoy the game, which is why it's so cheap.
I know I won't be rich, I just want to share it with all of you.

Have a nice day!

Ah! and try the game!! even the free demo. Ah!!! And leave a review!
Thanks!!!
